title: Split orchestrator into route-transformer and region-proxy layer
creator: Marin Alvarez
description: Background: The current routing orchestrator mixes policy evaluation, request normalization, and regional capacity concerns in a single hotpath. This has created contention points, made kernel-selection decisions difficult to reason about, and increased latency variance under regional load spikes. Goal: Decompose the monolithic orchestrator into two bounded components: (1) a pure route-transformer responsible for deterministic policy evaluation and canonical route metadata, and (2) a lightweight region-proxy layer that exposes an idempotent, lease-less interface for regional capacity checks and fast failover. Scope: - Extract policy and route transformation logic into a standalone module with deterministic inputs and functional tests. - Implement region proxies that maintain ephemeral region state without global locks (lease-less, event-sourced snapshot refresh). - Introduce a single-pass decision cache keyed on canonical route signatures and short-lived sequence windows. - Provide compatibility shims so existing callers can migrate incrementally. Why now: Ongoing incidents show that policy re-eval under load increases tail latency and contributes to cross-region contention. Decomposition will reduce lock contention, simplify telemetry, and open the door for safer per-region autoscaling heuristics.
acceptance_criteria: Route-transformer module compiles as an independent package with full unit test coverage (>=90%)
Region-proxy endpoints replace lock-based checks and show reduced p95 routing latency by >=20% in load tests
Decision cache hotpath instrumented and safe TTL-based invalidation implemented
Backward-compatible API surface: no changes required from downstream callers during migration
E2E load test (synthetic multi-region) shows no regression in throughput and meets latency SLOs

Implement route-transformer with pure policy evaluator and canonicalizer
Add integration tests for canonical route signatures across sample traffic
Prototype lease-less region-proxy and verify correctness under failover scenarios
Create decision-cache with metrics and TTL eviction policy
Build compatibility shim and feature flag for canary rollout
Run multi-region perf run on staging and capture dashboards
Ship incremental PRs and monitor canary for 48 hours before rollout
